name: Isabel Production Session State Backbone
purpose: Provide one shared source of truth across browser, Unreal, voice, screens, memory, approvals, work threads, and Isabel's physical state.
principles: subsystems publish observations and requests, not competing truths
state changes are versioned and attributable
identity, geometry, camera, authority, and approval integrity are protected invariants
reconnect restores only stable verified state
external actions are never replayed automatically after reconnect

approvals.rule: approval is valid only for the exact payload hash

conflict_rules: newer state_version wins only inside the same ownership domain
protected invariants cannot be overwritten by subsystem messages
physical TRANSITION never becomes restore target
approval records cannot be modified after approval; changed payload requires new approval
execution COMPLETE does not imply VERIFIED
memory OFFLINE cannot fabricate remembered preferences
restore_rules: resolve TRANSITION posture to nearest stable SEATED or STANDING state
restore stable_anchor, not raw world coordinates
restore active work thread and pending approvals
restore each monitor independently from last good route
preserve camera lock and geometry lock
acceptance: browser and Unreal show the same session_id and state_version
reconnect increments connection_epoch without creating a new work session
one screen may fail without corrupting other screen states
Isabel's stable anchor survives browser refresh
pending approvals survive reconnect and retain original payload hash
completed-but-unverified action remains unverified after restart
identity/camera/geometry locks remain unchanged through recovery
